Warwick.summary: His healing lets him dominate the early game, so buy anti-heal.

Vi.summary: A hard counter: she can interrupt your Q2 dash and cancel your ult knockup.

Zac.summary: A tank who soaks most of your damage, heals from his passive and can revive.

Nasus.summary: Rare in the jungle, but very dangerous once his stacks build up; expect a hard game.

Rengar.summary: He can one-shot you before you react. Rely on your team to deny him easy stacks and kills.

Khazix.summary: He can one-shot you quickly. Get a level lead and dominate him before his evolutions come online.

Kindred.summary: One of your easiest matchups: you can kick her out of her ult zone, and she is too squishy to survive outside it.

Chogath.summary: Extremely tanky even without stacks; late game you will struggle to damage him.

Shaco.summary: AD Shaco can one-shot you, while AP Shaco harasses you with boxes all over the map.

MasterYi.summary: Not overpowered if you know how to play Lee Sin well.

JarvanIV.summary: Weak in duels, but in teamfights his ult can trap you when there is no ally to W out to.

Gragas.summary: The author rates him among the hardest matchups but gives no specific counterplay.

Sylas.summary: Weaker in the jungle since his W nerf; you will usually hold a level advantage.

Amumu.summary: His CC does little in duels, but be wary of it in teamfights.

Diana.summary: Strong in both jungle duels and teamfights, so be cautious.

Fiddlesticks.summary: His drain healing and ult make him one of your hardest matchups.

Zed.summary: Not hard on paper, but without wards for your W escape you can die when he ults you.
